name: okdata-repo
description: One npm workspace for typescript/ (@okdata/sdk), cli/ (okdata) and mcp-typescript/ (@okdata/mcp), so the CLI builds and tests against the SDK in this repository.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w typescript && npm run typecheck -w cli && npm run typecheck -w mcp-typescript
scripts.test: npm test -w typescript && npm test -w cli && npm test -w mcp-typescript
scripts.build: npm run build -w typescript && npm run build -w cli && npm run build -w mcp-typescript
